name: José Joaquín Moraga
contribution: A Spanish colonial expeditionary and soldier who founded San Jose, California, in 1777.

checks.lead: José Joaquín de la Santísima Trinidad Moraga (22 August 1745 – 13 July 1785), usually simply known as José Joaquín Moraga, was a Spanish colonial expeditionary and soldier who founded San Jose, California, in 1777.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
